references.text: Akira, son of Enan, is first mentioned here as the leader of the tribe of Naphtali at the census.
Akira, son of Enan, brought his offering on the twelfth day as the leader of the tribe of Naphtali.
Akira, son of Enan, led the army of the tribe of Naphtali during the wilderness journey.
Naphtali was a son of Jacob and Bilhah, and the tribe traces its origin to him.
Jacob's blessing over Naphtali describing the character of the tribe.
